name: Streak
description: A habit tracker: habits checked day by day, with scores, charts and notes.

network.ws://127.0.0.1:7420: Syncs your habits with a document server on this computer.
network.https://id.example.com: Signs you in to the document server with Example ID.

capabilities.files: Saves a backup of your habits to a file you choose, and restores one.
capabilities.assistant: Answers your questions about your habits, with the assistant you set up in Settings.
